title: Calibration-free discrimination of unresolved sources with symmetric multiphoton measurements: code, numerical results and manuscript
description: Code, numerical results, pre-registration records, novelty checks and REVTeX manuscript (submitted to Physical Review A) for the paper 'Calibration-free discrimination of unresolved sources with symmetric multiphoton measurements'. Measure-first learners that calibrate the telescope pointing retain only a separation-independent fraction of the known-pointing quantum Chernoff exponent, whereas symmetric projection of stored photons needs no calibration and reaches (k-1)/k of the quantum limit.
